notes: Ketiv/qere unit WLC.JOS.2.13.v001 resolved to r00-base in the projection; no textual decision was made here (rule 9).
*save alive* is headed on *alive* as the lexeme-bearing complement (rule 44); the competing head on *save* is recorded in the unit note.

The suffix of lahem denotes the family rather than the relative's antecedent, so it is not resumptive: it takes the subject pronoun *they* under rule 18 while the possessive le carries *have* under rule 43.
